paper_protocol.source_gold: Withheld until each cohort was locked. Original source and trial files remain unchanged.
paper_protocol.blindness_limit: New to the application's checked development history; model pretraining exposure cannot be established.
paper_protocol.combined_input_disclosure: The second paper trial explicitly supplied 1 A as a user-selected linear-inductance normalization; it was not attributed to the paper.
paper_protocol.target_policy: Explicit published nonzero analytical, numerical or experimental references, with method/case/units preserved; no fitted targets.
paper_protocol.post_lock_source_risk: Independent inspection after outcome locks found the second PDF visibly uses microhenries (µH), while its frozen text extraction rendered mH. Literal acceptance could cause a 1,000-fold unit error. This did not cause the observed stops: no complete typed evidence or numerical target was accepted. Strict JSON and successful FEMM execution cannot establish that source units were read faithfully.

offline_corrections_after_failures: Smaller strict paper contracts replace the rejected monolithic evidence response.
Server normalizes opaque internal identifiers with a validated durable alias map; protected paper claim IDs retain their exact spelling.
Explicit component scope routes exterior air and measurements to settings without duplicate faces.
Shape-specific bindings are validated at the feature checkpoint as well as final compilation.
Natural-language lexical-presence checks are advisory; paper numerical/source checks stay strict.
Cancellation retains incomplete audits and unknown costs; an observed provider quota stops subsequent cohort requests.
Legacy preset and visual requests now use strict provider contracts without token caps or default AI deadlines.
offline_correction_live_status: Not retested against paid providers after quota exhaustion; native grammar acceptance and live reliability remain unverified.
